title: Conan and Agasa play a Card Game
titleZh: 柯南和阿笠博士玩纸牌游戏
statementMd:
Edogawa Conan got tired of solving cases, and invited his friend, Professor Agasa, over. They decided to play a game of cards. Conan has $*n*$ cards, and the $*i*$-th card has a number $*a*_{*i*}$ written on it.

They take turns playing, starting with Conan. In each turn, the player chooses a card and removes it. Also, he removes all cards having a number strictly lesser than the number on the chosen card. Formally, if the player chooses the $*i*$-th card, he removes that card and removes the $*j*$-th card for all $*j*$ such that $*a*_{*j*} < *a*_{*i*}$.

A player loses if he cannot make a move on his turn, that is, he loses if there are no cards left. Predict the outcome of the game, assuming both players play optimally.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of cards Conan has.

The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number on the $*i*$-th card.

## Output

If Conan wins, print "`Conan`" (without quotes), otherwise print "`Agasa`" (without quotes).

## Note

In the first example, Conan can just choose the card having number $7$ on it and hence remove all the cards. After that, there are no cards left on Agasa's turn.

In the second example, no matter which card Conan chooses, there will be one one card left, which Agasa can choose. After that, there are no cards left when it becomes Conan's turn again.
statementZhMd:
江户川柯南厌倦了解决案件，于是邀请他的朋友阿笠博士来家里。他们决定玩一个纸牌游戏。柯南有 $*n*$ 张牌，第 $*i*$ 张牌上写着一个数字 $*a*_{*i*}$。

他们轮流进行操作，由柯南先手。每次操作时，玩家选择一张牌并将其移除。同时，他还会移除所有数字严格小于所选牌上数字的牌。形式化地说，如果玩家选择了第 $*i*$ 张牌，那么他会移除这张牌，并且对于所有满足 $*a*_{*j*} < *a*_{*i*}$ 的 $*j*$，移除第 $*j*$ 张牌。

如果玩家在自己的回合无法进行操作，也就是说，场上没有剩余的牌，那么该玩家输掉游戏。假设双方都采取最优策略，预测游戏结果。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——柯南拥有的牌数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 张牌上的数字。

## 输出格式

如果柯南获胜，输出 "`Conan`"（不含引号）；否则输出 "`Agasa`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，柯南可以直接选择数字为 $7$ 的牌，从而移除所有牌。之后轮到阿笠博士时，场上已经没有剩余的牌。

在第二个样例中，无论柯南选择哪张牌，都会剩下一张牌，阿笠博士可以移除这张牌。之后再次轮到柯南时，场上已经没有剩余的牌。
